monad_strusd_identity_resolution.scope: Monad strUSD metadata identity only; no execution/redemption route simulation
monad_strusd_identity_resolution.finding: The directory underlying is a deployed strUSD decimals wrapper, not the documented base token. Its rawToken() identifies the exact documented Monad strUSD. The SY yieldToken is the wrapper, while accepted deposit/output token identities are the documented base strUSD. Keep the wrapper, base token and trUSD accounting reference distinct; no Ethereum or parent grade is inherited.
monad_strusd_identity_resolution.boundary: Identity only; no deposit/redeem simulation, sized quote, bridge route, backing verification or risk assessment.
